value.rationale: The 2026 filtered Thom–Sebastiani work motivates an exact infinite-iteration question. The theorem resolves its unrestricted nilpotent-Jordan version for every isolated hypersurface germ and identifies a universal sharp decay constant, a natural invariant of the Milnor-multiplication operator. This covers cases with nilpotency index >=3 outside the previously treated square-zero family; its applicability and constant are not supplied by the initial Milnor/Tjurina numbers alone. No claim of independent certification, Hodge filtration behavior, or broader theorem is made.
